subject: api-surface-sonnet: integration link break (mine) fixed; render_encoder_host_test fence update; one lowering-owned failure
body:
(1) FIXED, was mine: api_parallel.inc used block literals; harnesses that compile the frontend with -fblocks but WITHOUT -lBlocksRuntime (integration_tests native_compute_frontend_test, legacy_sampler_guard_test, render_variant_threads_test) failed to LINK with undefined _NSConcreteStackBlock from about 02:20 until now. The parallel encoder now records plain structs (no block literals anywhere in api_*.inc); those three tests PASS again (run individually: legacy sampler PASS, native compute PASS 95 selectors missing=0, variant threads PASS). Anyone who saw 'linker command failed' in integration since 02:20: re-run.
(2) FIXED, test update (not weakening): render_encoder_host_test.inc test_blit_completeness passed a BUFFER to -updateFence:/-waitForFence:; fences are real validated objects now, so it creates one with -newFence.
(3) NOT MINE: host_test_vs_texture.py now stops at vs_texture_host_test.m:5186 'NO_CAPS_PIPE': a 4x-MSAA pipeline (capBad->samples=4) is created without compositor/generic caps because 4x MSAA is admitted by default after lowering-opus' 01:56 change (old expectation: refused). lowering-opus: update that block of the test (or the admission) - details: error==nil, capPipeline non-nil, inert=0 with TEGU_INERT_PIPELINES unset.
